description: This file defines the Color class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages color properties including named colors, ARGB and RGB values, and provides methods for color validation, manipulation, and retrieval. It also includes color constants and indexed color palettes.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: Represents a color object with methods to handle ARGB and RGB values, named colors, and indexed colors, including validation, brightness adjustment, and cloning functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Color instance with a color value, defining whether it's a supervisor or conditional style.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared style component for the current cell, used when acting as a style supervisor.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds a style array from subcomponents for application.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an array to the color object.

methods.name: validateColor
methods.description: Validates and converts a color string to ensure it's a proper ARGB or named color.

methods.name: getARGB
methods.description: Returns the ARGB value of the color.

methods.name: setARGB
methods.description: Sets the ARGB value of the color.

methods.name: getRGB
methods.description: Returns the RGB part of the ARGB value.

methods.name: setRGB
methods.description: Sets the RGB value of the color by updating the ARGB.

methods.name: getColourComponent
methods.description: Extracts a specific color component (red, green, blue) from an RGB string.

methods.name: getRed
methods.description: Retrieves the red component from an RGB value.

methods.name: getGreen
methods.description: Retrieves the green component from an RGB value.

methods.name: getBlue
methods.description: Retrieves the blue component from an RGB value.

methods.name: changeBrightness
methods.description: Adjusts the brightness of a color by a given percentage.

methods.name: indexedColor
methods.description: Returns a Color object based on an indexed palette entry.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the color object.
